creator_belief.reason: The puzzle is a very sterile, efficient test of a specific box-ordering skill.

confidence_level.reason: It resembles classic, focused Sokoban puzzles, but the extreme efficiency feels more common in AI generation.

fun.reason: Solving the box-shuffling puzzle in the tight goal area was satisfying.

challenging.reason: The challenge was moderate; I had to think but it was not overly complex.

frustrating.reason: The puzzle was straightforward and I never felt stuck or annoyed by the design.
